prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray tan (airbrush/sunless) or UV tanning (beds)? And which part of Columbus (zip or neighborhood) or what’s your budget/event timeline?

If you want a quick way to find the “best” local salon, here’s what I recommend looking for and asking when you call or check reviews:

What to decide first
- Spray (sunless) vs UV beds — spray is safer and better for special events; beds give a true UV tan but carry skin-cancer risk.
- If you need a natural-looking result, short-notice, or have fair/difficult-to-tan skin, choose a professional spray-tech.

How to evaluate a salon
- Reviews: recent Google and Yelp reviews (4.5+ is strong).
- Technician experience and certifications (Norvell, St. Tropez, VersaSpa training).
- Portfolio/photos of real client results.
- Cleanliness and sanitation practices.
- Products used (brands and solution shades).
- Clear pricing, patch-test policy, and aftercare instructions.
- For UV: type of beds (high-pressure vs low-pressure), maintenance, and session policies.

Questions to ask a salon
- Which sunless brand/solution do you use and which shade would you recommend for my skin tone?
- Do you do patch tests for first-time clients?
- How long between sessions, and what aftercare do you recommend?
- For beds: what type of units do you use and how often are they serviced?
- Do you offer a satisfaction policy / touch-up if uneven?

Search queries you can run
- “best spray tan Columbus OH near me”
- “best tanning salon Columbus OH Google reviews”
- “spray tan near [zip code] Columbus OH”

If you tell me your neighborhood or zip code and whether you want spray or UV, I can narrow down options and give a short list of well-reviewed salons and what to expect from each.
